title: R003 OpenRouter DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 full blinded evidence-variant replication
research_question: Are the R001-R002 CyberDefender outcomes reproducible for DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 across the same incidents, profiles, and blinded evidence variants?
hypothesis: Prior model, profile, and evidence-variant effects may recur under an unchanged protocol, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: R003 independent replication of the complete R002 192-cell DeepSeek design. Relace remains pinned with fallback disabled. The provider-facing schema omits uniqueItems while the unchanged local validator enforces the complete schema. Every action remains broker-mediated and every attempt is retained.
